history.dynasty: Nath Sampradaya; Math founded 8th century by Guru Chauranginath, rejuvenated by Baba Mast Nath in 1791
history.period: Ancient Math (8th century); revival 1791; samadhi temple erected after the saint's samadhi
history.summary: The Baba Mast Nath Temple is the samadhi and Math complex at Asthal Bohar (6-7 km east of Rohtak city on NH-10, Rohtak tehsil, Haryana), the main centre of the 18th-century Nath saint Baba Mast Nath (born 1764 in Kansreti/Bohar village, Rohtak district, per Wikipedia; lived about a century per hagiography). The Asthal Bohar Math was established by Guru Chauranginath in the 8th century; after a period of neglect Baba Mast Nath re-established it in 1791, and after he took samadhi his disciples erected the samadhi temple in his honour. The Math is managed by the Mastnath Math Trust; the annual Baba Mast Nath Fair is held at the samadhi on Phalguna Sudi 7 (February-March) for three days (Saptami to Navami), drawing devotees for worship, wrestling matches and community feasts. Baba Mastnath University was established in his name in 2012 by his seventh disciple Mahant Chandnath. TOWN CORRECTION: the CSV town 'Rohtak' is imprecise - the temple/math is at Asthal Bohar village, recorded here with the corrected town. CONFLICTS: sources agree on the 1791 re-establishment; the founding date (8th century) and hagiographic details rest on oral/local tradition. A separate, smaller 'Baba Mast Nath Temple' listing exists at Sector-27, Maina (Rohtak city); this file documents the Asthal Bohar Math, the canonical and best-documented referent.

name: Baba Mast Nath Temple
town_description: Asthal Bohar is a village 6-7 km east of Rohtak city on NH-10 (the Delhi highway) in Rohtak district, Haryana. It is known for its ancient Math and sculptural finds, and for the Asthal Bohar paintings done in the Rajput style.
